name: OlympicArena
intro: OlympicArena 是覆盖七个科学领域的双语多模态奥林匹克推理基准，收录62项竞赛的11,163道题，并以答案级和过程级协议评估模型的认知推理与视觉推理能力。
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Soochow University, GAIR
build_method: 公开竞赛材料整理, Mathpix与人工标注, 多轮验证和模型辅助能力标签
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
task_type: 数学问题, 多学科推理
eval_feature: 双语, 多学科, 答案级与过程级评测, 认知与视觉推理标签
build_method_en: Public Competition Materials, Mathpix and Human Annotation, Multi-round Validation and Model-assisted Skill Labels
eval_feature_en: Bilingual, multidisciplinary, answer- and process-level evaluation, cognitive and visual reasoning labels
intro_en: OlympicArena is a bilingual multimodal Olympiad reasoning benchmark spanning seven scientific fields. It contains 11,163 problems from 62 competitions and evaluates cognitive and visual reasoning with answer-level and process-level protocols.
scale_en: 11,163 problems, 62 competitions, 7 fields, 7,571 images, 13 answer types
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.12753 and the official GAIR-NLP/OlympicArena repository. The diagrams preserve public PDF sourcing from 62 Olympiad competitions across seven fields; licensed problem and solution collection and CS test cases; Mathpix Markdown conversion; extraction by about 30 STEM students through the released annotation interface; multi-step validation; within-competition and same-year embedding deduplication; GPT-4V cognitive-difficulty labels with manual verification; eight logical and five visual reasoning categories; the 11,163-problem release with 7,571 images, 13 answer types, and 7,904 solved problems; splits of 548 OlympicArena-ot problems, 638 validation problems with steps, and the remaining official test set; image, caption, and text-only zero-shot settings; rule matching, CS pass@k, and GPT-4V answer judging with manual sampling; plus the 96-problem process evaluation with GPT-4/GPT-4V step scoring and 83% inter-annotator agreement.
